Thanks — quick technical note from my side: for the pen-test on-boarding I'd like to confirm which environments the vendor will target (staging vs. dedicated test infra). We prefer pen-tests to run against our staging clusters where we have snapshots and can coordinate rollback. If Fydia's vendor needs production-level data access for validation, we'll need a short JIRA change and an emergency rollback window — that will push the pen-test to the following week.

Also, can the vendor provide an IDS/scan timebox? We usually limit automated destructive scans to a 2-hr window and require a point of contact on both sides.

If Option A works for Fydia but the vendor needs a production-level check, propose we keep Controls on Oct 21 morning and move the pen-test to Oct 28. That gives us time to open the change ticket.

-Ben
